theorems.statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Ps : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Ps t).massOn W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Ps t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X r)) → ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass) → ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact K → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T.boundary → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (K) → T ω = 0) → T.mass ≠ ∞ → T.boundary.mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R₁ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S₁ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity R₁ ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S₁ ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), T ω - Q ω = R₁.boundary ω + S₁ ω) ∧ Q.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.mass ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.boundary.mass ∧ R₁.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.mass ∧ S₁.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.boundary.mass ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) ({x : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z} ∩ cthickening (Real.sqrt P) K) → Q ω = 0) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 2))) (cthickening (Real.sqrt P) K) → R₁ ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (cthickening (Real.sqrt P) K) → S₁ ω = 0
